title: Marangoni swimmer-spread loop 1 (seed 500, negative for the capability): with all founders mar 40 and in-run mutation in the dense-disc environment, the trait mean rises only in the escape arm (40 -> 45.7, mar-60 kind 20-33% of bodies late; twin 36.7) but the share of dividing rods that swim 3 of their own lengths does not (E 1 of 17, twin 2 of 17, C 0 of 14, drive-off 0 of 18)
summary: c45's three-kind ladder (mar 20/40/60, majority-feedback surfactant copied through fission, mutation 2.5e-3 per body per frame) in c45's dense sink-disc environment, all founders of the middle kind, one fresh seed with four arms: escape (E), no-escape removal (C), identical-event twin (MARS 40/40/40) and drive-off (MARS 0). The pre-registered trait mean (ladder value of living bodies) rises in E only (45.7 at T=2000 vs 36.7 twin), with the mar-60 kind appearing by mutation and holding 20-33% of bodies from t 1300; mar-40 bodies escape discs 23/35 and mar-20 bodies 0/3. But the M-gate share of dividing rods (3 own rod lengths with the rear tip advancing) is 1 of 17 in E with none late, against 2 of 17 in the twin, and the selection gradient on distance per cycle is +0.00 [-0.19, +0.40]: this environment selects the faster kind without selecting the capability. No conversions outside mutation; 1-3 off-kind daughters per 44-62. C collapses to one body (removal destroys matter), and all arms are small (6-25 bodies).

finding.operator: heritable Marangoni-coefficient ladder (self-copied surfactant kinds) with in-run mutation in growing sink discs
finding.control: no-escape removal arm C, identical-event twin (MARS 40/40/40) and drive-off (MARS 0), same seed 500
finding.result: trait mean at T=2000: E 45.7, twin 36.7, off 40.0, C 1 body; M-gate passers among dividing rods: E 1/17, twin 2/17, C 0/14, off 0/18; escape share E 0.57 (k0 0/3, k1 23/35, k2 1/2), twin 0.71, off 0.25; D gradient E +0.001 [-0.19,+0.40]
